loops.title: Ship PR Until Green
loops.description: Implement on a branch, run tests, push, open a PR, wait for CI, and loop until checks pass and the PR is ready to merge.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: PR is open with all CI checks passing
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics

steps.label: Implement and test
steps.description: Make the scoped change and run local tests.

steps.label: Commit and push
steps.description: Commit with a clear message and push the branch.

steps.label: Open or update PR
steps.description: Open a PR with summary and test plan, or update existing PR.

steps.label: Fix CI
steps.description: If CI fails, read logs, fix once locally, push, and re-wait.

flow.exitLabel: PR checks pass and PR is merge-ready

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Ship PR Until Green" loop.

Goal: PR is open with all CI checks passing
Max iterations: 10
Between iterations run: gh pr checks
Exit when: all PR checks are success

Step 1: Implement the change, test locally, push, open PR, and fix CI until green.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: CI Failure Watcher
loops.description: Poll CI on an interval, investigate failures when checks go red, and push fixes until green.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: latest CI run on this branch is green
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition

steps.label: Check CI status
steps.description: Poll the latest workflow run on the current branch.

steps.label: Read failure logs
steps.description: If red, pull logs and identify the smallest root cause.

steps.label: Fix and verify locally
steps.description: Patch once, run the failing check locally if possible.

steps.label: Push and wait
steps.description: Push the fix and wait for CI to rerun.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
/loop 5m Start the "CI Failure Watcher" loop.

Goal: latest CI run on this branch is green.
Max iterations: 12.
Between iterations run: gh run list --branch $(git branch --show-current) --limit 1
Exit when: latest run conclusion is success.

Step 1: Check CI status. If failed, read logs, fix root cause, verify locally, and push if needed.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: PR Self-Review
loops.description: Review your own diff like a senior reviewer, fix issues, and repeat for three passes before opening the PR.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: three clean self-review passes on the current diff
loops.exitCondition: three passes complete with no critical findings
guardrails: Do not rubber-stamp the diff to hit the iteration count
Report critical findings honestly even on the final pass

steps.label: Review diff
steps.description: Read the diff like a senior reviewer — correctness, edge cases, naming, tests.

steps.label: Fix findings
steps.description: Address critical and high findings before the next pass.

steps.label: Re-review
steps.description: Run another pass on the updated diff.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "PR Self-Review" loop.

Goal: three clean self-review passes on the current diff
Max iterations: 3
Between iterations run: git diff main...HEAD
Exit when: three passes complete with no critical findings

Step 1: Review the diff like a senior reviewer. Fix findings, then re-review.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Test Until Green
loops.description: Run your test suite, fix the smallest root cause on failure, and repeat until every test passes.
loops.author: Trooper
guardrails: Do not weaken or delete tests to force green
Fix the smallest root cause per iteration

steps.label: Run tests
steps.description: Execute the full or scoped test suite.

steps.label: Triage failures
steps.description: Pick the smallest root cause from the failure output.

steps.label: Fix and re-run
steps.description: Patch, then run tests again.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Test Until Green" loop.

Goal: all tests pass
Max iterations: 10
Between iterations run: npm test
Exit when: tests exit 0

Step 1: Run tests. If there are failures, fix the smallest root cause, then repeat.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Babysit PR
loops.description: Keep a PR merge-ready by triaging review comments, fixing CI, and updating the description until reviewers approve.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: PR has approvals and all checks green
loops.exitCondition: reviewDecision is APPROVED and all checks success
guardrails: Do not dismiss valid review feedback without addressing it
Do not force-merge or bypass required checks

steps.label: Check PR status
steps.description: Read review decision and check rollup.

steps.label: Address comments
steps.description: Reply to or fix outstanding review threads.

steps.label: Fix CI / update PR
steps.description: Push fixes and refresh the PR summary if scope changed.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
/loop 10m Start the "Babysit PR" loop.

Goal: PR has approvals and all checks green
Max iterations: 15
Between iterations run: gh pr view --json reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup
Exit when: reviewDecision is APPROVED and all checks success

Step 1: Check PR status. Address review comments and CI failures until merge-ready.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Lint Until Clean
loops.description: Run the linter, fix violations in small batches, and repeat until the repo is clean.
loops.author: Trooper
guardrails: Do not disable lint rules to force a pass
Prefer fixing root causes over blanket suppressions

steps.label: Run linter
steps.description: Execute the project lint command.

steps.label: Fix batch
steps.description: Resolve a focused batch of violations.

steps.label: Re-run lint
steps.description: Confirm the batch cleared and scan for remaining issues.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Lint Until Clean" loop.

Goal: linter exits with zero errors
Max iterations: 8
Between iterations run: npm run lint
Exit when: lint exits 0

Step 1: Run the linter. Fix violations in small batches until clean.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
